corrections.text: Still, you did not choose this fate either, did you, "Lady of Thorns"...
corrections.reason: Root source review restores the actor/action direction or omitted meaning and removes duplicated narration; Lady of Thorns belongs to Hazel, a woman, rather than a male prince.

uncertainties.note: Lady of Thorns and Coral Viper are provisional English title renderings. Japanese titles and Hazel identity are corroborated by https://w.atwiki.jp/sn3psp/pages/21.html and https://w.atwiki.jp/aniwotawiki/pages/16123.html; no authoritative English title found.

notes: Root independently compared all source and English VM boxes3246–3945, including boundary and gender-alternate scenes. Spelling normalization follows meaning corrections.
